A '''captain''', in the employ of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]], was responsible for the unauthorized extortion of [[Mandal Hypernautics Corporation|Mandal Hypernautics]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] that led to the acquisition of the [[Keldabe-class cruiser|''Keldabe''-class battleship]] and the [[Canderous-class assault tank|''Canderous''-class assault tank]] by the Zann Consortium. Despite the benefits, [[Tyber Zann]] executed the Pirate Captain, as he believed that tolerating disobedience would ultimately weaken the Consortium.
